messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off marketplace onboarding for Dedicated (AWS/GCP/Azure). Main open question: SKU and packaging model for trial vs paid. Need legal T&Cs alignment, product packaging (features per SKU), and billing metadata.

alex: Thanks — can we keep trial SKU lightweight (no dedicated GPU guarantees) and map Dedicated tiers to RDW-DED-STD / RDW-DED-PRO / RDW-DED-ENT?

samir: Agree on tiers. Product note: PRO includes autoscale burst, ENT includes SSO + KMS. Trial should be RDW-DEMO-TRIAL-30D and expire automatically.

katie: Legal flags: auto-expire is fine but trial conversions need explicit consent for billing. Also need to confirm data residency language for Azure Gov/govcloud customers. I'll draft language.

maria: Good call. Also need SKU-level metadata: billing dimensions (vCPU-hours? token-units? reserved-hours?), trial -> no charge but meter usage for telemetry.

ryan: For billing tags we can surface: "capacity_tier", "trial_flag", "region_restriction", "kms_required". I'll add to listing manifest. Example snippet:```json
{
  "sku": "RDW-DEMO-TRIAL-30D",
  "dimensions": ["tokens", "reserved_gpu_hours"],
  "metadata": {"trial": true, "region": "*"}
}
```

alex: Nice. Who owns the marketplace asset (logos, screenshots, deploy templates)? Marketing or partnerships?

maria: Partnerships owns the listing pipeline, marketing owns creative. We'll add runbook tasks.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Marketplace publishers require contact email + support URL + legal entity DUNS/Tax ID. See https://console.marketplace/requirements

katie: I'll need the support URL and standard SLA statement. Also ask finance for tax ID — cc @alex.

samir: Packaging decision: do we bundle example terraform + helm chart in the listing, or just link to GitHub? My vote: include a small quickstart asset and link to full repo.

alex: +1. Quickstart should show Dedicated -> private VPC wiring + KMS step. Keep code sample minimal.

maria: Action items: 1) Katie to draft trial conversion T&Cs by EOD Tue. 2) Ryan to add SKU metadata to manifest + example quickstart by Thu. 3) Alex to collect finance/legal IDs and marketing assets by next Mon. 4) Samir to finalize feature matrix per tier. I'll update the onboarding tracker.

katie: I'll post draft here when ready. :thumbsup:

ryan: Pushed initial manifest to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/manifests/rdw-dedicated.json (commented).

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll sync Thurs 11am to review final packaging before publisher submission.

alex: 11am works for me.

samir: Added a few sample CTAs for the listing in the tracker.

marketplace-bot: Submission checklist progress: branding=missing, support_url=present, legal_docs=pending, quickstart=missing.

maria: I'll chase branding. If anyone has questions ping me or drop updates in this thread.
